scope: Read-only current RLS policy and table owner/ACL readback; no user rows or policies changed.
query: BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='10000ms'; SELECT clock_timestamp()::text AS observed_at,(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.tablename,p.policyname) FROM pg_policies p WHERE p.schemaname='public' AND p.tablename IN('rakeback_periods','rakeback_period_payouts')) AS policies,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'acl',c.relacl,'rls',c.relrowsecurity) ORDER BY c.relname) FROM pg_class c WHERE c.oid IN('public.rakeback_periods'::regclass,'public.rakeback_period_payouts'::regclass)) AS access;COMMIT;

policies.qual:
(club_id IN ( SELECT c.id
   FROM clubs c
  WHERE (c.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid))))
policies.policyname: club owners read own club rakeback

policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM club_members cm
  WHERE ((cm.club_id = rakeback_periods.club_id) AND (cm.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))
